target.outcome: Incident daily reported COVID-19 cases and deaths
target.pollutant: NO2 (with all five article pollutants in native output)
target.period: 24 February–19 May 2020; 86 of the article's intended 89 days
target.effect_scale: Rate ratio per 1 microgram per cubic metre
target.exposure_assignment: Unweighted mean of monitor-level daily means within each documented region polygon; LTAP is 2013–19 May 2020 monitor-day mean
target.model: Pollutant-specific Poisson GEE with log link, AR(1) working correlation, STAP, LTAP, and lockdown
target.named_outcome_source: Italian Protezione Civile regional COVID-19 series

substitutions.reanalysis: Current official EEA E1a parquet download API
substitutions.reason: Legacy route returned HTTP 401; current official EEA records were usable.
The retained public regional outcome CSV starts 24 February; no data were fabricated.
Meteorology is supplementary in the article; primary model is retained.

coverage.rule: Report-only completeness; retain all dates with at least one regional monitor and retain all two regions.
coverage.notes: No retained region/pollutant/date has missing STAP. Full retrieval has 408 retained EEA station series and 13,651,225 normalized observations.

blockers: Only two regional clusters: GEE robust uncertainty is not reliable for inference.
Three intended early dates are absent from retained public outcome data.
Meteorology-adjusted supplementary variants were not fit.

design_provenance.assignment_method: For each region/pollutant/date, mean each monitor's within-day values then take the unweighted mean across contributing monitors. This is a regional monitor summary, not population-weighted or personal exposure.
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: STAP = regional daily mean for 21 February–19 May 2020. LTAP = mean of all valid monitor-day concentrations from 1 January 2013 through 19 May 2020 within the same region and pollutant.

coverage_policy.evidence: Report-only: retain a region/pollutant/day if at least one monitor contributes, and report days and monitor counts. No post-hoc exclusion threshold.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: The article defines regional daily concentrations and an eight-year regional mean but does not specify a population weighting or numeric completeness threshold. Equal weighting of daily monitor means is an explicit, reproducible regional-monitor interpretation. The current official EEA parquet service is a source/transport modernization of the article-named EEA database, not a change in pollutant, period, region, or metric.
evidence_basis: Deterministic 3-sampling-point-per-region/pollutant probe retrieved 29 valid EEA E1a parquet objects; one missing object preserved as a failure.
Probe yields 86/89 target-date records per region/pollutant with no missing STAP among retained rows and 2–3 contributing monitors per region/pollutant.
Executable acquisition, point-in-polygon assignment, validity handling, daily aggregation, and diagnostics code.

reported_variants: all five pollutants in native output
